function laplace(matrix)
    n = size(matrix, 1)
    n == 1 && return matrix[1, 1]
    total = 0
    for j = 1:n
        columns = [k for k = 1:n if k != j]
        term = matrix[1, j] * laplace(matrix[2:end, columns])
        total += isodd(j) ? term : -term
    end
    return total
end

matrices = [
    [2 -3 1; 5 4 -2; -1 6 3],
    [3 0 -2 5; 1 4 7 -3; -6 2 1 8; 9 -5 3 2],
    [4 -1 7 0 -3; 2 8 -5 6 1; -9 3 2 -4 5; 6 0 -7 3 -2; 1 -6 4 9 8],
]
for matrix in matrices
    n = size(matrix, 1)
    println("det(", n, "x", n, ") = ", laplace(matrix))
end
